Pohrebyshche Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Pohrebyshche's Jewish community, present from the early 17th century, was destroyed during the Khmelnytsky uprising of 1648, reviving by the century's end with its synagogue rebuilt in 1690; it suffered further pogroms in 1736 and 1768. The community reached 2,494 people (40 percent of the town) by 1897. The Yiddish-language writer Michael (Mishe) Lev, who lived from 1917 to 2013, was born here. About 1,360 Jews were murdered here in October 1941; roughly 300 Jews still lived in Pohrebyshche as of 1990.
